items.title: Apache Software FoundationのApache Camelにおけるエラーメッセージによる情報漏えいに関する脆弱性
items.body: Apache CamelのCoAPコンポーネントにおける機密情報を含むエラーメッセージ生成の脆弱性について説明します。この問題は、Apache Camelのバージョン4.0.0から4.18.5未満、ならびに4.19.0から4.22.2未満のバージョンに影響を与えます。CoAPコンシューマがルート完了後にレスポンスを構築できなかった場合、CamelCoapResourceは発生した例外を捕捉し、そのメッセージを5.00 Internal Server ErrorレスポンスのペイロードとしてCoAPクライアントに送り返していました。典型的なケースとしては型変換の失敗があり、コンシューマはルート終了後にルートのエラーハンドラ外で最終メッセージボディをbyte[]ペイロードに変換し、CamelCoapMaxAgeおよびCamelCoapETagヘッダーをそれぞれの型に変換していました。該当のリリースでは、この失敗メッセージに変換対象の値のクラス名、値の文字列表現、さらに根本原因のクラス名とメッセージが含まれていたため、遠隔のCoAPクライアントは内部の展開詳細（クラス名やパッケージ名、ファイルパスなどの値の文字列形式、そして根本原因に含まれるパス、ホスト名、接続情報など）を読み取ることが可能でした。HTTPコンシューマとは異なり、コンシューマ側にはこの情報漏えいを抑制するオプションがなく、muteExceptionオプションは提供されていませんでした。また、失敗したルートによる例外は送信されず、コンシューマは交換が失敗したかどうかを確認せずに、ルート失敗に対して2.05 Contentとその時点のメッセージボディを応答していました。したがって、この情報漏洩を引き起こすためには、ルートの完了レスポンスを遠隔クライアントが変換不能にできる必要があり、これはルートの実装方法に依存します。ユーザーには本問題を修正したバージョン4.23.0へのアップグレードを推奨します。4.22.x系の利用者は4.22.2へ、4.18.x系の利用者は4.18.5へのアップグレードを推奨します。4.14.x系以前および4.15.xから4.17.x、4.19.xから4.21.xのリリースラインは問題解決前にサポートが終了しており修正が提供されませんので、これらの環境はサポート対象のリリースへの移行が必要です。アップグレードのみで対応可能であり、新たに追加されたmuteExceptionコンシューマオプションは3つの修正済みリリースラインでデフォルトtrueに設定されているため、設定変更なしにエラーレスポンスにペイロードは含まれません。即時アップグレードが難しい場合は、ルート完了後に必ずレスポンスが構築可能であることを確認してください。たとえば、coapエンドポイントを消費する各ルートの最後のステップでメッセージボディをbyte[]またはStringに変換（convertBodyToなどを使用）し、CamelCoapMaxAgeおよびCamelCoapETagヘッダーにはそれぞれの型の値のみを設定し、onExceptionハンドラを追加して失敗を処理済みとしてマークしレスポンスボディを明示的に設定することで、変換失敗をルート内で処理および置換し、コンシューマ側での変換失敗を回避できます。

items.title: OpenSSL ProjectのOpenSSLにおける制限またはスロットリング無しのリソースの割り当てに関する脆弱性
items.body: 問題の概要：OpenSSLのQUICサーバー（Listener SSLオブジェクト）が不明な宛先接続IDに対する有効なQUIC Initialパケットを処理する際、制限を設けずに新しい受信チャネルを割り当ててキューに入れることがあります。影響の概要：リモートピアが多数のInitialパケットをアプリケーションが接続を受け入れるよりも速くサーバーリスナーに到達させると、チャネルごとの状態を保持するためのメモリ割り当てが無制限に増大し、QUICリスナーが使用不能になり、サービス拒否（DoS）を引き起こす可能性があります。CWE：CWE-770：制限やスロットルなしのリソース割り当て説明：受信QUICパケットを処理する関数はパケットヘッダーのConnection-Idを用いて既存の接続（QUICチャネル）を探します。既存の接続が見つからずパケットタイプがINITIALの場合、この関数はパケットを新規接続として扱います。新しいチャネルオブジェクトを割り当て、それをキューに挿入し、ローカルアプリケーションによるSSL_accept(3ossl)での受け入れを待ちます。アプリケーションがSSL_accept()を十分頻繁に呼び出してこれらの受信接続要求に対応できない場合、これら初期チャネルオブジェクトによるメモリ消費は無制限に増加し続ける可能性があります。この問題はQUICサーバー実装が追加されたOpenSSL 3.5以降に存在します。修正により保留中接続数に制限が導入されました。デフォルトの制限は256の保留中接続（ローカルアプリケーションでの受け入れ待ち）です。アプリケーションはSSL_set_value_uint(3ossl)を呼び出すことでこのデフォルトを変更できます。FIPSへの影響：なし。FIPSモジュールの境界外にQUIC実装があるため、FIPSモジュールには影響がありません。

items.title: Zephyr ProjectのZephyrにおける型の取り違えに関する脆弱性
items.body: ネイティブ BSDソケット層は、型パニングによって struct net_context の void* user_data フィールドに未処理の非同期ソケットエラーを記録しました（ctx-＞user_data = INT_TO_POINTER(-status) は zsock_accepted_cb()、zsock_received_cb()、zsock_connected_cb() および zsock_close_ctx() の subsys/net/lib/sockets/sockets_inet.c で行われます）。それを POINTER_TO_INT() で読み戻します。同じフィールドは、待ち受け TCP コンテキストをネットワークスタックが所有しており、net_tcp_accept() が親コンテキストポインタをそこに格納し、TCP コアが登録済みの accept コールバックにそれを返します。したがって、受理に失敗すると、スタックは struct net_context を期待している場所に errno 値という小さな整数を残してしまいます。

items.title: Zephyr ProjectのZephyrにおけるNULL ポインタデリファレンスに関する脆弱性
items.body: subsys/net/lib/lwm2m/lwm2m_message_handling.c の parse_write_op() は、Block1 オプションを含む受信した CoAP WRITE/CREATE リクエストを処理します。転送の最初のブロックについては、init_block_ctx() を呼び出し、その後すぐに block_ctx-＞ctx.block_size = block_size を設定して、戻り値を調べる前に peer が選択したブロックサイズを格納しています。init_block_ctx() は呼び出し元のポインタを NULL に設定し、static block1_contexts[] プールの空きエントリがなくタイムアウトした場合には -ENOMEM を返します。これにより、格納操作が NULL ポインタを参照してしまう問題が発生します。このプールには CONFIG_LWM2M_NUM_BLOCK1_CONTEXT エントリ（デフォルトは3）があります。エントリは転送が完了するか失敗するか、あるいは30秒が経過するまで再利用されません。クライアントの LwM2M ソケットに到達するピアは、CoAP More ビットを設定したまま、3つの異なるオブジェクトパスに対してブロック単位の書き込みを3つ開始し、それらを未完了のままにしておき、別のパスで4つ目の書き込みの最初のブロックを送信して、保護されていない参照に到達します。到達性としては、CONFIG_LWM2M_DTLS_SUPPORT が有効化されているわけではなく、デフォルトで無効です。したがって NoSec 配置の場合、経路上の攻撃者やアドレス偽装者は資格情報を必要としません。同じシーケンスはブートストラップサーバや信頼度の低いサーバからも到達可能であり、4つの同時ブロック転送を行っている正当なサーバによって偶発的に発生する可能性もあります。この書き込みは固定の低位アドレスに対して0〜7の値を持つため、結果として致命的なメモリ障害（BusFault または低位メモリの破損による障害）を引き起こし、実用的なメモリ破壊プリミティブにはなりません。デバイスはクラッシュまたはリセットされますが、機密性と完全性には影響しません。修正では、格納操作をガードの下へ移動し、戻り値のコードではなくコンテキスト・ポインタ自体を検証します。これにより、コンテキストが有効であることを確認してからのみ操作を行うようにしています。

items.title: Zephyr ProjectのZephyrにおける複数の脆弱性
items.body: MCUmgr の SMP-over-console トランスポートは base64 フレームをデコードし、その後 16 ビットのパケット長を読み取り、CRC を検証したうえで、rx_ctxt-＞nb-＞len -= 2U; により末尾の CRC を無条件に削除します（これは mcumgr_serial_process_frag()（subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/transport/src/serial_util.c）で行われます）。mcumgr_serial_extract_len() は宣言された長さに関わらず受け付け、0 や 1 の長さも含みます。長さ 0 を宣言するパケットは crc16_itu_t() が 0 バイトに対してゼロ値を返すため、チェックサム検査を問題なく通過します。net_buf::len が uint16_t 型であるため、減算はアンダーフローを引き起こし、バッファは SMP に対して約 65 KB のペイロードを持つと主張しますが、そのデータ領域は CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_NETBUF_SIZE バイト（デフォルトは 384）に限られています。トリガーは、管理コンソール上の認証されていない 7 バイトの 1 行（0x06 0x09 のパケット・マーカーに続く base64 グループ AAA= と改行）で、これをこのヘルパーに基づいて構築された任意のトランスポートへ配信します。対象は CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_UART (smp_uart.c) または CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_SHELL (smp_shell.c) のいずれかで、どちらも MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_SERIAL_HAS_SMP_OVER_CONSOLE を選択しています。事前のセッション状態やフラグメンテーション、認証情報はアンダーフローを引き起こすために必要ありません。破損したフレームはコマンドハンドラやコマンドレベルのアクセス制御が実行される前に誤って処理されます。攻撃者はそのコンソールへ書き込みアクセスさえ確保すればよく、多くのボードではそれが裸の UART ヘッダではなく USB CDC-ACM ポートである場合が多いです。長さが膨らむと、subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/smp/src/smp.c の smp_process_request_packet() は境界を見失います。cbor_nb_reader_init() は CBOR デコーダに約 65 KB のウィンドウを 384 バイトのバッファで与え、各リクエスト・ヘッダの nh_len は膨らんだ長さのみでチェックされます。7 バイトのフレームは再利用されたプール・バッファにまだ保持されている古いバイトを再解析し、通常は以前に受信したリクエストのリプレイや解析エラーを含み、バッファを解放しません。とはいえ、トランスポートは認証されていないため、攻撃者はトリガー前に送信されるフレームも制御可能であり、バッファ内容を操作して nh_len がバッファを超えるリクエストを成功させることが可能です。net_buf_pull() は __ASSERT_NO_MSG によってのみ保護されており、パースカーソルを境界外へ移動させ、ループは隣接メモリからさらにヘッダと CBOR を読み込みます。その結果、境界外読み取りが発生し、MCUmgr スレッドをクラッシュさせる（サービス拒否）可能性があります。メモリ開示も発生し得ます。デフォルトで有効な os echo ハンドラ（CONFIG_MCUMGR_GRP_OS_ECHO）はこのウィンドウ内の文字列をデコードしてレスポンスにコピーします。認証されていないトランスポートは既に許可されている範囲を超える完全性向上を提供しません。修正は mcumgr_serial_extract_len() にて宣言された長さが 2 バイト以下のものを拒否するため、CRC 削除の減算がアンダーフローを引き起こさなくなっています。同様のパターンはテスト専用のループバック・トランスポート subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/transport/src/smp_dummy.c（CONFIG_MCUMGR_TRANSPORT_DUMMY）にも残っていますが、外部からの入力経路が存在しないため、実際の攻撃対象とはなりません。

CVE-2026-99284 - In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: skbuff...
items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: skbuff: propagate shared-frag marker in skb_zerocopy()

skb_zerocopy() moves frag descriptors from @from into @to and takes a
reference on each frag, but it does not copy skb_shinfo(from)->flags into
skb_shinfo(to)->flags.  A destination skb holding the same page-cache
backed frags as the source therefore reports skb_has_shared_frag() as
false.

That breaks the invariant relied on by later in-place writers.  ESP input
checks skb_has_shared_frag() before deciding whether an uncloned
nonlinear skb can skip skb_cow_data(); with the marker lost, an skb that
skb_zerocopy() built for nfnetlink_queue or for an openvswitch upcall is
decrypted in place, letting an unprivileged user write into the page
cache of a root-owned read-only file.

Propagate SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG when frag descriptors are copied, as done for
the other frag-transfer helpers.

CVE-2026-99283 - In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

netfilter: conntrack: tcp: use UNACK timeout for non-closing RST packets

Commit be0502a3f2e9 ("netfilter: conntrack: tcp: only close if RST
matches exact sequence") keeps an established conntrack entry in
ESTABLISHED when an in-window RST does not match the expected sequence
number exactly, so the endpoint can validate the RST with a challenge
ACK.

The timeout selection nevertheless uses the CLOSE timeout for every RST
packet.  The bug is that timeout selection is based on the packet type,
not on the state transition result: even when RST validation keeps
new_state in ESTABLISHED, the timeout is still forced to
TCP_CONNTRACK_CLOSE.

Linux TCP independently rate limits challenge ACKs per socket.  A second
non-exact RST can therefore arrive after the first challenge ACK has
restored the timeout but before the rate limit expires.  The second RST
lowers the timeout to 10 seconds again while the endpoint suppresses the
second challenge ACK, allowing the conntrack entry to expire while both
TCP endpoints remain established.

Using the ESTABLISHED timeout for such RSTs would avoid this short
expiration window, but it could also retain stale entries for the
five-day default because conntrack cannot reliably match the endpoint's
exact TCP state.

Use the UNACK timeout for RST packets that leave the conntrack entry in
TCP_CONNTRACK_ESTABLISHED.  Exact-match RSTs and accepted RST packet
trains still fall through to timeouts[new_state], which preserves the
CLOSE timeout when conntrack accepts the RST as closing the flow.

This avoids the aggressive 10-second expiration window for non-exact
RSTs while preserving the short timeout for RSTs that conntrack accepts
as closing the flow.

items.title: CVE-2026-119164 - The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in a...
items.body: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.2 via the `data[secondary_groupids]` parameter of the `wpforo_action_profile_update` POST handler. This is due to a type-confusion flaw in the secondary_groupids authorization guard within the `Members::update()` function in `classes/Members.php`, where casting a scalar CSV string (e.g. `"0,1"`) with `(array)` before `array_map('intval', …)` and `array_filter()` produces an empty array — causing the guard's outer conditional, and the else-branch that would otherwise strip the field from the update, to be bypassed entirely — while `encode()`/`decode()` downstream correctly explodes the original CSV and persists the attacker-supplied group IDs to `wp_wpforo_profiles.secondary_groupids`. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to escalate their forum privileges to wpForo Administrator by injecting the privileged Admin group ID, granting access to the Forum Accesses editor and the ability to rewrite forum-wide capability policies for all members and edit arbitrary content owned by other users. Exploitation requires the attacker to have at least 3 approved wpForo posts to satisfy the plugin's default `min_number_posts_to_edit_account` antispam gate, along with a valid wpforo nonce obtained from their own account profile form.

items.title: CVE-2026-118784 - The WPSpeed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in...
items.body: The WPSpeed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 2.6.10 This is due to a combination of two issues in the LightImages HTML optimizer: (1) Dispatcher::runOptimize() decides whether the current request is the site's home page by comparing only the URL path from REQUEST_URI against the path of the home URL, so on a plain-permalinks install the author archive URL /?author=<ID> is treated as the home page and the LightImages optimizer runs on it; and (2) LightImages::optimize() calls html_entity_decode() across the entire serialized DOMDocument output under the default-enabled img_processing_entity_decode setting, converting any entity-encoded markup present as plain text in the page (including WordPress's rendered author title) into live HTML. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to store entity-encoded markup in their own nickname/display_name through the normal profile endpoint and have that markup rehydrated into executing script when any logged-out visitor loads their author archive.

This exploit chain is reachable only on sites where an administrator has created a custom wpForo secondary usergroup with a blank WordPress role and the 'mth' (Manage Themes) capability; on such sites, an attacker can self-register and claim that group via the unguarded wpforo_secondary_groupids[] POST field, bypassing the role-based group filter and gaining theme-management access as a Subscriber.

items.title: CVE-2026-107616 - The Amelia plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of attendee...
items.body: The Amelia plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of attendee data due to a missing authorization check on the GetEventAttendeesCommandHandler::handle() function in versions up to, and including, 9.9.1. The handler only enforces the broad `amelia_read_events` capability — which the plugin's own `wpamelia-customer` role possesses — and does not verify that the authenticated user is an organizer/provider of the event referenced by the client-supplied `id` query parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with wpamelia-customer-level access and above, to export the full CSV of attendee personally identifiable information (first/last name, email, phone, date of birth, gender, private notes, payment amounts/methods, WooCommerce order IDs, custom-field values, and uploaded-file URLs) for any Amelia event on the site by directly invoking the `/report/event/attendees` endpoint with an arbitrary event ID.

items.title: CVE-2026-103900 - The WPJAM Basic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in ve...
items.body: The WPJAM Basic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in versions up to, and including, 7.1 This is due to the WPJAM_User_Signup::signup() function unpacking attacker-supplied `data[args]` from the AJAX POST body and merging it via PHP array union into the payload passed to WPJAM_User::create(), whose internal whitelist (wpjam_pick) explicitly preserves the `role` key before it is handed to wp_insert_user(). The endpoint is registered as wp_ajax_nopriv_{provider}-signup with a nonce that is emitted on the public login page. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to elevate their privileges to Administrator by creating a new user with an attacker-chosen role, provided a social-login provider is registered and open registration is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-120477 - The Stop Spammers Classic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Sit...
items.body: The Stop Spammers Classic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' POST parameter in versions up to, and including, 2026.6. An unauthenticated POST handled on init stores the attacker-supplied author field (after sanitize_text_field, which does not escape single quotes) into the ss_stop_sp_reg_stats option history. The Log Report admin page then renders that stored value inside a single-quoted JavaScript string within a double-quoted onclick attribute using esc_js(); because esc_js() uses _wp_specialchars with ENT_COMPAT it does not escape single quotes, allowing the stored value to break out of the JS string literal and inject arbitrary JavaScript. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute whenever an administrator with manage_options access clicks the 'Report to SFS' link on an attacker-poisoned log row (the StopForumSpam API key must be configured for that link to be rendered — the field is empty by default). Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

items.title: CVE-2026-94619 - FileGator is a multi-user file manager. Prior to 7.15.0, POST /upload in backend...
items.body: FileGator is a multi-user file manager. Prior to 7.15.0, POST /upload in backend/Controllers/UploadController.php uses the request-supplied resumableFilename as an unnamespaced key in shared temporary storage. In a multi-user deployment configured with distinct per-user home directories, a low-privileged user with upload permission can set resumableTotalChunks and resumableTotalSize to zero so the assembly loop writes no data, after which the handler reads a pre-existing temporary file with that name, stores it in the attacker's home directory, and removes it. The same filename path can append data when chunks are supplied, allowing disclosure, modification, or deletion of another user's transient object, including a pending archive or the login rate-limit lockfile, while Tmpfs path sanitization limits the primitive to the temporary directory. This issue is fixed in version 7.15.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-94618 - FileGator is a multi-user file manager. Prior to 7.15.0, GET /batchdownload in b...
items.body: FileGator is a multi-user file manager. Prior to 7.15.0, GET /batchdownload in backend/Controllers/DownloadController.php uses batchDownloadStart() to stream a shared temporary archive selected by the request-supplied uniqid without checking that the current session created it. In deployments with distinct per-user home directories, a valid user with read, download, and batchdownload permissions who obtains another user's active archive id can cross that boundary and retrieve the victim's batch archive. The archive lifetime and id-acquisition requirement limit exploitation, but a successful replay also deletes the victim's pending archive. This issue is fixed in version 7.15.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-77442 - Ryot is a self-hosted personal tracking application. Prior to 10.4.0, the create...
items.body: Ryot is a self-hosted personal tracking application. Prior to 10.4.0, the createOrUpdateUserIntegration GraphQL mutation in crates/services/user/src/integration_operations.rs allows a low-privileged authenticated user to supply another user's integrationId to create_or_update_user_integration() without an ownership check. SeaORM treats the supplied primary key as an update target, and the operation assigns the caller's user_id while replacing the targeted integration's provider_specifics and other configuration, which can transfer ownership, overwrite configuration, or disable the victim's integration. Exploitation requires obtaining the victim's non-brute-forceable integration id, and the vulnerable update does not disclose existing stored credential values. This issue is fixed in version 10.4.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-69128 - Chartbrew is an open-source web application that can connect directly to databas...
items.body: Chartbrew is an open-source web application that can connect directly to databases and APIs and use the data to create charts. In 5.2.2, the AI SQL blocklist omitted sibling PostgreSQL filesystem functions and failed to match double-quoted identifier forms of denied functions. The vulnerable surface is the AI query tool's PostgreSQL SQL-validation blocklist. A team Owner or Admin uses an AI-enabled PostgreSQL connection whose database role can call server-side file functions and causes generated SQL to use an unlisted sibling function or a double-quoted denied function. Unlisted sibling functions remain allowed, and double-quoted function identifiers bypass the denylist regular expressions and reach PostgreSQL. AI features must be enabled and the user must have elevated Chartbrew privileges. A PostgreSQL superuser or pg_read_server_files role can resolve absolute paths to files readable by the PostgreSQL OS user, while a non-superuser is limited to the source-stated PGDATA-relative scope. This vulnerability is fixed in 5.2.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-68935 - Chartbrew is an open-source web application for creating charts from databases a...
items.body: Chartbrew is an open-source web application for creating charts from databases and APIs. In versions 4.8.5 through 5.2.2, API connection creation and update operations accept the internal  allowPrivateHost  field from user input. An authenticated user with permission to manage API connections can enable this field to bypass private and reserved-network destination restrictions. An upgrade migration also enables the override on pre-existing API connections. The per-connection setting takes precedence over  CB_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK_CALLS , so disabling that instance option does not protect connections with the override enabled. Successful exploitation allows requests to internal HTTP services reachable from the Chartbrew server, potentially disclosing information or triggering unauthorized actions depending on the target service. Recognized cloud metadata endpoints remain separately blocked. This issue is fixed in version 5.2.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-68933 - Chartbrew is an open-source web application that can connect directly to databas...
items.body: Chartbrew is an open-source web application that can connect directly to databases and APIs and use the data to create charts. Prior to 5.2.3, public dashboard passwords were stored in plaintext, accepted through a URL query parameter, and checked without effective attempt throttling. The vulnerable surface is public password-protected dashboard storage and validation routes. An unauthenticated attacker targets a public password-protected dashboard and repeatedly submits candidate passwords or obtains password-bearing server or proxy logs. Unlimited online guesses enable brute force, while cleartext storage and URL transport expose the secret in application storage and server or proxy access logs. The target must be a public dashboard with password protection enabled. Even failed attempts reveal chart count and configuration without the password; a recovered password grants access to the protected dashboard and its chart data. This vulnerability is fixed in 5.2.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-59104 - UgCS server before 6.2 contains an authentication bypass in the HCI protocol log...
items.body: UgCS server before 6.2 contains an authentication bypass in the HCI protocol login handler (LoginHandler) exposed on TCP port 3334. When the user database contains exactly one user (the default single-operator installation), a LoginRequest with empty userLogin and userPassword fields is interpreted as \"use the only user\" rather than as invalid credentials, and the server returns a fully authenticated session. Because the service listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) without TLS by default, an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to port 3334 can obtain an authenticated session without knowing any credential and then issue privileged commands, including commanding connected drones and uploading flight routes.

items.title: CVE-2026-48057 - Botan is a C++ cryptography library. Prior to 3.13.0, Botan's X.509 Distinguishe...
items.body: Botan is a C++ cryptography library. Prior to 3.13.0, Botan's X.509 Distinguished Name decoder flattens the Attribute-Value Assertions in each Relative Distinguished Name and loses multi-value RDN grouping before DN name-constraint enforcement. An attacker controlling a name-constrained intermediate CA can issue a certificate with a multi-value RDN whose first Common Name matches the permitted constraint and whose second Common Name is attacker-chosen, causing the constraint check to accept the flattened first value. If the certificate contains no subjectAlternativeName extension, the second Common Name can then be accepted as a hostname; Botan does not fall back to Common Name hostname matching when any subjectAlternativeName is present. The exposure is limited to deployments using DN name constraints, which are uncommon outside internal PKIs, and to certificates without a subjectAlternativeName. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-47738 - liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of po...
items.body: liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of post-quantum cryptography algorithms. Prior to 0.16.0, OQS_KEM_encaps_derand can dereference an uninitialized encaps_derand function pointer when called on NTRU-HPS-2048-509, NTRU-HPS-2048-677, NTRU-HPS-4096-821, NTRU-HPS-4096-1229, NTRU-HRSS-701, or NTRU-HRSS-1373. The affected NTRU constructors omit the OQS_KEM.encaps_derand member because those schemes do not support derandomized encapsulation, OQS_KEM objects are allocated without zero initialization, and the wrapper in src/kem/kem.c checks only that the OQS_KEM pointer is non-null before calling through the residual heap value. An application is affected only if it instantiates one of those six NTRU KEMs and invokes OQS_KEM_encaps_derand on it. The supported impact is a calling-process crash and denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 0.16.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-44519 - liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of po...
items.body: liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of post-quantum cryptography algorithms. Prior to 0.16.0, the ct_select function in src/kem/frodokem/external/util.c for the FrodoKEM-640, FrodoKEM-976, and FrodoKEM-1344 AES and SHAKE reference variants lacks a value barrier in the Fujisaki-Okamoto implicit-rejection path. When compiled with Clang 17 or later at an affected optimization level such as -Os, the compiler can emit a secret-dependent conditional load, causing the real and rejection secret paths to leave distinguishable cache residency after successful and failed decapsulation. A local attacker able to perform repeated cache-timing measurements may use this oracle as part of a private-key recovery attack. Default -O3 builds vectorize both source loads and do not exhibit the reported behavior, and the advisory does not report the same generated memory-access pattern in NTRU, NTRU-Prime, BIKE, HQC, Classic McEliece, Kyber, or the already-barriered ML-KEM implementation. This issue is fixed in version 0.16.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-104267 - Botan is a C++ cryptography library. From 2.7.0 until 3.13.0, Botan's Scrypt imp...
items.body: Botan is a C++ cryptography library. From 2.7.0 until 3.13.0, Botan's Scrypt implementation on 32-bit platforms computes required memory with unchecked multiplication, allowing attacker-controlled Scrypt parameters to wrap the allocation size and create a buffer smaller than the algorithm subsequently writes. The issue affects systems that enable Scrypt and accept arbitrary parameters from a hostile source, including applications that decrypt attacker-supplied encrypted private keys. A triggering parameter set can cause approximately four gigabytes of Scrypt output to be written past the allocated heap buffer, immediately crashing the process and causing denial of service. Arbitrary code execution is not demonstrated and appears difficult, but cannot be excluded from the overwrite primitive. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-104254 - liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of po...
items.body: liboqs is a C-language cryptographic library that provides implementations of post-quantum cryptography algorithms. From 0.11.0 through 0.16.0, builds configured with OQS_ENABLE_SIG_STFL_LMS=ON can read beyond a caller-supplied signature buffer when an untrusted truncated LMS or HSS-LMS signature reaches OQS_SIG_STFL_verify or OQS_SIG_STFL_alg_lms_verify. In hss_validate_signature_init() in src/sig_stfl/lms/external/hss_verify_inc.c, consumed-length checks do not ensure that the bottom-level q and C fields remain available, allowing up to 32 bytes to be read past the buffer. In version 0.16.0, is_hss_public_key() also reads at offset 8 after only a four-byte length check, allowing an over-read of up to eight bytes. No valid signature is required, but the public key must be syntactically plausible. The read data is consumed only by an internal hash and is not exposed, so the supported impact is a possible verifier crash and denial of service, not memory disclosure or acceptance of an invalid signature. This issue is scheduled to be fixed in version 0.17.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-103022 - Urwid is a console user interface library for Python. Prior to 4.0.7, handle_sho...
items.body: Urwid is a console user interface library for Python. Prior to 4.0.7, handle_short_request() in urwid/display/web.py performs unguarded character encoding on POST input and unguarded UTF-8 decoding on polling update socket output. A remote attacker who obtains a valid X-Urwid-ID session token can submit non-ASCII POST data that raises UnicodeEncodeError, while non-UTF-8 polling output raises UnicodeDecodeError, causing the CGI handler to return an error and terminate request processing. The POST exception path also leaves an opened file descriptor unclosed for the CGI process lifetime, so repeated requests can cause denial of service for the web display interface. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-108262 - DDEV is an open-source tool for running local web development environments for P...
items.body: DDEV is an open-source tool for running local web development environments for PHP and Node.js. From 1.25.2 until 1.25.4, Untar in pkg/archive/archive.go validates an absolute tar symlink target after rebasing it beneath dest, but creates the symlink with the raw absolute Linkname. A crafted archive can therefore plant a host-absolute symlink and use a following regular-file entry to write outside the extraction directory. The flaw is reachable through remote add-on retrieval and database or file imports, and overwriting shell startup files, Git hooks, or cron entries can lead to code execution in the DDEV user's context. Unzip is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.25.4.

CVE-2026-100082 - In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-blkback...
items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-blkback: Avoid UAF when reading I/O statistics

Reading I/O statistics via sysfs concurrently with tearing down a
frontend device might result in UAF or a NULL dereference, as the
reading of the statistics data is not synchronized with freeing the
data.

Use a rwlock for synchronizing.

This is XSA-528 / CVE-2026-100082

CVE-2026-100081 - In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback...
items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback: defer xenvif_mcast_addr_list_free()

In order for the function to legitimately avoid locking/RCU, it needs to
run after all TX/RX processing has finished/stopped: Lookups happen from
xenvif_start_xmit(), while adds/removes happen from xenvif_tx_action()
(called out of xenvif_poll()).

Move the call out of xenvif_disconnect_data() (the call to the function
from connect()'s error path doesn't require any cleaning up there), and
put it past the synchronization point in backend_disconnect().

This is XSA-527 / CVE-2026-100081.

items.title:
CVE-2026-100080 - In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback...
items.body:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xen-netback: Fix UAF when reading statistics data

The network statistic data in the driver is protected by RCU.
Unfortunately when tearing down the queues after an error during
connecting to the frontend (e.g. due to illegal Xenstore data filled
in by the guest), the statistic data is being freed without
synchronizing the RCU state.  In case the data is being read via sysfs
in this phase, access to already freed memory or memory being in new
use is possible.

Fix that by calling synchronize_net() before freeing the queue data.

This is XSA-526 / CVE-2026-100080

items.title: CVE-2026-85742 - FreeScout is a self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox. Prior to 1.8.230, a pre...
items.body: FreeScout is a self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox. Prior to 1.8.230, a pre-authenticated attacker can place HTML in a failed-login email value that is copied through monitored user activity into a queued SendAlert job. If alert delivery fails, the serialized payload is stored in failed_jobs and the administrator job-details endpoint renders it after a blacklist sanitizer that leaves executable event-handler attributes. When an administrator opens /system/ajax-html/job_details/{id} as a top-level page, the raw fragment lacks the normal layout policy and attacker-controlled JavaScript can perform same-origin administrator actions. Logs Monitoring for users, a failed alert email job, queue failure storage, and top-level administrator interaction are all required; the normal modal path is not affected in the tested configuration. This issue is fixed in version 1.8.230.

items.title: CVE-2026-75598 - The Gradle Shadow plugin creates fat or uber JARs and supports file transformati...
items.body: The Gradle Shadow plugin creates fat or uber JARs and supports file transformation and package relocation. Prior to version 9.6.0, Shadow does not independently validate ZIP entry names before writing them to its output archive. A malicious dependency can cause traversal entry names to be preserved when the applicable archive-processing path does not reject them. Some affected Shadow implementations process dependency archives directly, so upgrading Gradle alone does not universally prevent this behavior. If the resulting archive is extracted without path traversal protection, attacker-controlled files can be written outside the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 9.6.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-123973 - SharePoint Products CopyMove before 2026-11-06 allows traversal. An authenticate...
items.body: SharePoint Products CopyMove before 2026-11-06 allows traversal. An authenticated SharePoint user with the necessary permissions to use the ZIP import functionality may exploit a path traversal vulnerability in CopyMove for SharePoint 2019 and CopyMove for SharePoint V6 by supplying a crafted ZIP archive. A path traversal vulnerability in the ZIP import functionality of SharePoint Products ApS CopyMove for SharePoint 2019 and CopyMove for SharePoint V6 allows a user with access to the ZIP import functionality to supply a crafted ZIP archive containing malicious entry paths. items.title: CVE-2026-123824 - The Symfony Config component XmlUtils::parse() enables DTD validation before rej...
items.body:
The Symfony Config component XmlUtils::parse() enables DTD validation before rejecting documents that carry a doctype, allowing XML external entity (XXE) injection in Symfony versions prior to 5.4.56, 6.x prior to 6.4.50, 7.x prior to 7.4.23, and 8.x prior to 8.1.11. A remote attacker who can supply XML to this method can determine whether local files exist, cause a denial of service, and, in some configurations, exfiltrate local file content via a crafted XML document whose doctype declares an external file:// entity.
XmlUtils::parse() sets $dom->validateOnParse = true before calling loadXML() and only rejects documents carrying a doctype afterwards. Enabling DTD validation makes libxml resolve external entities during loadXML(), and LIBXML_NONET blocks http:// but not file://, so a file:// entity is read from disk before the doctype rejection runs. The content of the file is not returned to the caller, but the distinct libxml error for a missing path reveals whether a file exists, and an entity pointing at a large or slow file causes a denial of service. If the application registers a network-capable stream wrapper such as s3://, a parameter entity can also send the content of a local file to an external server. This is the same issue as CVE-2026-45071, which was fixed in the DomCrawler component but not in Config.

Applications are affected if they pass untrusted XML to XmlUtils::parse() directly. The Symfony components that call it process developer-provided or operator-configured sources, such as configuration files and the XLIFF documents fetched by the translation providers.

items.title: CVE-2026-118670 - OHIF Viewers is a zero-footprint DICOM viewer with shared extension packages. Fr...
items.body: OHIF Viewers is a zero-footprint DICOM viewer with shared extension packages. From 3.5.0-beta.0 until 3.12.15, 3.13.7, and 3.14.0-beta.19, the dicom-pdf extension reads the attacker-controlled MIMETypeOfEncapsulatedDocument value in extensions/dicom-pdf/src/getSopClassHandlerModule.js and uses it as the Blob media type for the attacker-controlled EncapsulatedDocument bytes. When a victim opens Encapsulated PDF SOP Class 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.104.1, extensions/dicom-pdf/src/viewports/OHIFCornerstonePdfViewport.tsx embeds the Blob URL in an object element. A Blob labeled as HTML is handled as HTML despite the application/pdf object hint, and the Blob inherits the OHIF origin, allowing embedded script to access session storage, authentication tokens, and same-origin PACS requests. The malicious DICOM object may be opened locally, uploaded to a shared PACS, or supplied by a DICOMweb source. This issue is fixed in source versions 3.12.15, 3.13.7, and 3.14.0-beta.19.

items.title: CVE-2026-102650 - Nuxt Content is the file-based CMS for Nuxt applications, powered by Markdown an...
items.body: Nuxt Content is the file-based CMS for Nuxt applications, powered by Markdown and Vue components. From 3.0.0 until 3.15.2, the unauthenticated POST /__nuxt_content/:collection/query endpoint accepts an attacker-controlled sql field in src/runtime/api/query.post.ts and permits expensive SQLite expressions. Version 3.0.0 performed no query validation; in affected releases using assertSafeQuery in src/runtime/internal/security.ts, the reported validation gap rejects a short list of SQL command keywords in WHERE clauses but permits function calls including randomblob(), zeroblob(), hex(), and length(). The query reaches the synchronous better-sqlite3 sink in src/runtime/internal/database.server.ts, allowing a single remote request to consume substantial CPU and memory while blocking the Node.js event loop and all concurrent request handling. Fully static prerendered deployments that do not expose the server endpoint are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 3.15.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-102359 - Kroki creates diagrams from textual descriptions. Prior to 0.31.2, the TikZ back...
items.body: Kroki creates diagrams from textual descriptions. Prior to 0.31.2, the TikZ backend's tikz/tikz2svg guard used when KROKI_SAFE_MODE is enabled blocks only \verbatiminput while allowing native TeX file-read primitives including \openin, \read, \input, and \include. TeX Live's permissive openin_any setting remains active, so an unauthenticated actor can submit crafted LaTeX to POST /tikz/svg or the generic diagram API and cause the renderer to read any file accessible to the Kroki container user. The file contents are rendered into the returned SVG, which may disclose mounted secrets, configuration data, credentials, private keys, or process environment data. The -no-shell-escape option prevents shell execution but does not restrict these native file operations. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-102356 - Kroki creates diagrams from textual descriptions. From 0.26.0 until 0.31.2, the ...
items.body: Kroki creates diagrams from textual descriptions. From 0.26.0 until 0.31.2, the optional Mermaid companion's mermaid/src/worker.js renders attacker-controlled flowchart image nodes in headless Chromium without a network request policy, even when KROKI_SAFE_MODE is set to secure. An actor who can submit Mermaid source and satisfy any authentication or authorization configured by the deployment can cause the companion to issue HTTP or HTTPS GET requests when requesting PNG output. Exploitation requires the Mermaid companion, PNG rendering through its headless Chromium process, a diagram-submission path available to the actor, and network reachability from the companion to the target. The demonstrated impact is limited to blind request reachability and possible state-changing GET endpoints; response exfiltration, cloud metadata access, port scanning, and access beyond the companion's network reachability are not established. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.2.
